Kemi Adeyemi: Hey folks, tiny onboarding calendar question  - my Day 1 invite duplicated and one shows as 00:00 (all-day). How do I remove the midnight placeholder without declining the real meeting?
Victor Ramos: Hi @Kemi - decline the all-day one and uncheck "send response" in Outlook. On GCal delete the event labeled "Onboarding placeholder". We will update the exporter to avoid this.
Kemi Adeyemi: Thanks. Also the invite mentions "recording posted after" but no link when the session ended. Where should I expect it?
Onboard Bot: @channel Recording flow: Zoom cloud -> processing -> copied to onboarding S3 -> presigned link posted in #new-hires (within ~30m) -> archived to Onboarding Drive/Notion within 48h. Presigned links expire in 7 days.
Riley Fox: If you get a Zoom passcode prompt when following a cloud link, reply here. Calendar Team will either give a direct S3 link or a temporary passcode.
Kemi Adeyemi: I'm APAC, might not watch same day. If the presigned link expires, how do I get longer access?
Calendar Team: We copy final recordings + VTT captions to the onboarding Drive and Notion. That copy is viewable org-wide within 48h. If you need extended access sooner, file an IT ticket and we'll issue an extended pre-signed URL.
Kemi Adeyemi: Nice. Can ICSs include a short note pointing to the expected recording landing spots (S3/Notion/Drive)? Saves follow-ups.
Victor Ramos: Good suggestion. We'll add a line to the ICS export: "Recording link posted in #new-hires; archived to Onboarding Notion/Drive within 48h." Patch scheduled tonight.
Onboard Bot: Calendar sync v2.19 scheduled: deploy to staging 03/27 22:00 UTC, prod 03/28 02:00 UTC. Will notify channel when live.
Kemi Adeyemi: One last small ask: captions/transcripts availability?
Onboard Bot: Captions: embedded in MP4 + separate VTT transcript posted alongside presigned link. Both copied to Drive/Notion archive.
Kemi Adeyemi: Perfect, thanks everyone! :pray:
